result.summary: Found 2 issues: a major text truncation problem in the restaurant listings and a minor layout issue with overflow content.

issues.description: Restaurant name 'Trattoria Piccol' is cut off in the 'Fastest near you' section. The text appears truncated and the full restaurant name is not visible.
issues.suggestion: Ensure the restaurant card has adequate width and implement text truncation with ellipsis (...) if needed, or use a scrollable horizontal layout to show the full name or allow the card to resize properly

issues.description: The category filter buttons on the top (All, Pizza, Sushi, Burgers, Healthy) have a partially visible/cut-off button on the far right edge, indicating horizontal overflow.
issues.suggestion: Ensure all filter buttons are fully visible, use a scrollable carousel for category filters, or adjust button sizing and spacing to fit all categories within the viewport
